name: QuillBot
summary: Paraphrasing, grammar, summarising and plagiarism checking in one box of writing utilities.
best_for: students, non-native writers and anyone who wants quick paraphrasing, grammar and summarizing help
skip_if: you already use a general AI assistant that paraphrases and edits — QuillBot may be redundant
honest_knock: The free tier is deliberately narrow: 125 words per paraphrase and two of the modes. The honest framing is that this is a box of writing utilities -- paraphraser, grammar, plagiarism, AI detection -- rather than somewhere you actually write. General AI chat tools now overlap much of it. And treat the free AI detector as weak: in our test of 1 October 2026 it rated four plainly written machine texts 100% human and only caught a paragraph full of stock chatbot phrases. Note the sticker too: the advertised €8.33 a month assumes you pay for the year, and month-to-month is €19.95, about 2.4 times as much.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month, or $8.33 a month billed annually ($99.95 a year)
pricing.notes: Read in a browser on quillbot.com/premium from a US exit (New York) on 8 September 2026, with the annual toggle operated in both positions; an EU read on 7 September showed the same figures in euros. Free at $0 (paraphrase up to 125 words in 2 modes, humanizer up to 125 words and 6 uses a day, summaries to 1,200 words). Premium is $19.95 a month month-to-month, or $8.33 a month billed annually ($99.95 a year), which the page presents as 58% off. The 40%-off promotion that showed $5.00 and ran to 6 September 2026 has ended. A Team plan exists but carries no public price; it routes to an enquiry. The old /pricing URL still returns 404, and /upgrade shows a sign-up wall when signed out. Re-read 26 September 2026 in a browser from a Netherlands exit with the toggle operated in both positions: EUR 19.95 a month month-to-month and EUR 8.33 a month billed annually, still labelled 58% off; Team still routes to an enquiry.
